question_prompt: Q15: Which of the following trends is the most important reason why your company would do more skills-based hiring (e.g., coding tests, writing tests, technical knowledge standardized tests) in the future?
panels: Q15: Which of the following trends is the most important reason why your company would do more skills-based hiring (e.g., coding tests, writing tests, technical knowledge standardized tests) in the future?
answers: Increasing use of technology, AI, and automation — skills tests are the most accurate way to see if applicants have good digital skills
Increased diversity, equity, and inclusion — evaluating based on skills tests removes unconscious bias
People switching careers into our industry, so we rely on skills tests rather than traditional education or work experience to evaluate them
Remote work opening up our candidate pool, so we need tests to weed out more candidates quickly and fairly
Not applicable — I don’t think we will do more skills-based hiring in the future
